senses.sense_definition: A luminous electrical discharge that appears on pointed objects during stormy weather.

examples.text: The sailors watched in awe as a <w>corposant</w> glowed brightly at the tip of the ship's mast.
During the intense thunderstorm, a faint <w>corposant</w> appeared on the lightning rod of the tall building.

traits.comment: This term is rarely used in modern English, having been largely replaced by St. Elmo's fire.
